Why it matters

Maintenance is not optional.

Neglecting a site is a liability. Here is what is at stake.

Outdated plugins = hacked sites

Over 90% of WordPress hacks exploit outdated plugins. We keep everything patched before vulnerabilities are exploited.

Downtime costs real money

Every minute your site is down, you're losing leads. Our uptime monitoring catches issues before your customers do.

Speed directly affects revenue

A 1-second delay in load time can drop conversions by 7%. We optimize continuously so you stay fast.

You should focus on your business

Website maintenance is technical, time-consuming, and never-ending. Let us handle it so you don't have to.
